item.title: Who Killed Alonzo Brooks And Why?
item.description: Alonzo Brooks disappeared after attending a party in rural Kansas in April 2004, and his body was found nearly a month later in a creek. A new federal autopsy determined that his death was a homicide, and the FBI has investigated whether he was the victim of a racially motivated killing. Nearly two decades later, no one has been charged.

item.title: The NBA Star Who Was Taken And Murdered
item.description: Former NBA player Lorenzen Wright disappeared in July 2010, and his body was found 10 days later in a Memphis field, riddled with gunshot wounds. The case remained unsolved for years until investigators arrested his ex-wife and her close associate. She pleaded guilty to facilitating the murder, while Billy Ray Turner was convicted of first-degree murder and sentenced to life in prison.

item.title: He Just Wanted A Happy Family Life
item.description: Cody Johnson dreamed of building a happy family, but his life ended in a devastating act of violence. What followed exposed a heartbreaking story of family conflict, unanswered questions, and a tragedy that left those closest to him searching for answers.

item.title: The Very Suspicious Case Of Jessica Easterly
item.description: Jessica Easterly told friends she was finally ready to leave her allegedly abusive husband—but before they could help her escape, she vanished. Days later, her body was found just blocks from her home, and years later her death remains surrounded by unanswered questions, with her family still fighting for justice.

item.title: Fitbit Exposed The Lie After A Mother's Murder
item.description: Connie Dabate was a devoted mother of two whose life ended just days before Christmas when her husband claimed a masked intruder had killed her. But data from Connie's Fitbit, combined with other evidence, unraveled his story and exposed a calculated murder plot driven by deception, infidelity, and betrayal.

item.title: The Doctor Who Murdered His Own Wife
item.description: Michele MacNeill died while recovering from cosmetic surgery after her husband, Dr. Martin MacNeill, claimed she had suffered a medical complication. As their daughters began uncovering his lies, investigators revealed a chilling plot involving prescription drugs, a hidden affair, and a murder staged to look like a tragic accident.
